question: Does learnable ordered RGB evidence at original-resolution boundaries discriminate coordinate actions beyond geometry, interior appearance and spatially shuffled boundary differences?
motivation: Prior hand statistics collapse spatial order; frozen stride8 ROI features downsample tiny structures. Test ordered native image differences, not altered thresholds or continued training of those stopped representations.
sample: Exactly candidate18 original128 fitting and64 head-held-out train images with unchanged action menus/owners. Detector already trained on these images; repeated holdout is not independent confirmation.
budget: Read192 original images, zero detector forwards or detector training. Four residual MLPs of32 hidden units,8epochs, batch512, AdamW lr0.0002 weight_decay0.0001. Seed0 first; repeat1/2 only if every seed0 gate passes. No learned backbone or crop search.
boundary: Each action: four sides,8 equally spaced positions from0.1 to0.9 along side, five signed normal offsets[-2,-1,0,1,2] ORIGINAL pixels. Positive normal points inside. Bilinear BGR samples, border replicate,160 RGB triplets=480 values. Subtract samples at the frozen uniform action and divide255.
interior_control: Same480 values from a10x16 interior grid spanning0.1..0.9 of each action box, subtract uniform samples and divide255.
shuffle_control: Same boundary difference values, shuffle160 spatial RGB triplets using a deterministic image/anchor hash, identical permutation across the six actions. Preserves peraction color moments and paired differences; discards globally aligned side/normal/position identity.
heads: Frozen historical uniform utility is unchanged. Add an MLP residual from68 historical normalized action geometry features plus480 image differences. All four MLPs share initial weights; last layer is zero, exactly preserving uniform before fitting. geometry_residual zeros the480 image inputs; other arms use interior_difference, boundary_difference or boundary_shuffled. Nominal capacity matches, active input capacity differs.
supervision: Same nominal-owner labels for all arms. Train rows at calibrated score>=0.05 with >=2 valid actions. Owned rows: all valid unordered action pairs with abs nominal same-GT IoU gap>0.01, average softplus(-sign*utility_difference/0.05). Unowned rows: prefer the frozen uniform action over other valid actions using the same softplus temperature. Rows without comparisons contribute zero. No stable-order labels or GT-dependent pixel sampling.
inference: Apply residual only to score>=0.05 rows with>=2 valid actions; use original select_actions rule and unchanged six action coordinates. Preserve count, order, class and score. At zero residual, all choices must exactly equal cached uniform.
primary: Full one-to-one detection matching at confidence0.25 and ten IoUs0.50:0.05:0.95 on64 heldout images, average tiny/small_all recall. Not official AP/AR.
pass_action: Only permits a separately registered official/repeated-scene feasibility audit and closer prior comparison. Boundary sampling, learned image quality and relative ranking are not independently novel.
fail_action: Stop this fixed native-pixel-difference representation and residual recipe. Do not change offsets, grid sizes, normalization, labels, epochs, learning rate or seeds to rescue it.
limits: No new detector generalization, small scene split, inherited uniform diagnostic ignore rows, GT annotation uncertainty, native boundary pixels may describe occluders rather than object extent. BorderDet/SABL already establish boundary-aware features/localization; a positive proxy alone would not establish originality.
